checkpoints.quote: This message is displayed in a modal dialog, blocking further interaction with the login screen. The "OK" button is the only available action for the user.

checkpoints.quote: Assign the ticket to a developer or analyst to investigate the root cause of the error message. … Request clarification from the customer or product owner about the intended behavior of the error message. … To confirm whether the app should block login entirely or provide an alternative path for users who cannot complete the questionnaire.
checkpoints.reason: The analysis covers assigning the ticket and confirming with the product owner about blocking behaviour, but does not mention giving support an answer for the customer who currently cannot use the app at all.
The analysis only quotes the error text that matches the screenshot and does not invent any additional error codes, session-expired messages, or authentication failure text.
The analysis does not claim the customer can dismiss the dialog to continue, nor does it state the password was entered and rejected.
